data.headline: BorgWarner Secures Its First 48V Electric Cross Differential Program
data.summary: BorgWarner has secured a new electric cross differential (eXD) program with a leading Chinese original equipment manufacturer (OEM). The eXD solution is designed for a 48V system and is integrated with the customer's 48V electrical and electronic (E/E) architecture. This program represents BorgWarner's first 48V eXD application within its global portfolio and expands the company's torque management capabilities for electric vehicles.

data.headline: BorgWarner Expands Series-Production Battery Management System Program with a Global OEM
data.summary: BorgWarner's battery management system (BMS) has been selected for an expanded series-production program with a global original equipment manufacturer (OEM). The expanded award will support additional B-segment and C-segment passenger cars, as well as light commercial vehicles for battery-electric vehicle (BEV) and plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) applications beginning in 2029.
